title: SFO–YVR: Ishan Cole
notice: Source-reviewed against Canadian government publications on 2026-10-25. Passenger and document data are fictional; no independent human review is claimed.

review.notes: Checked the authored evidence path, exceptions and disposition against ca-us-pr. See docs/content-review-2026-10-25.md. This is an agent source review, not independent human or immigration-authority approval.

assumptions: Adult passenger on the direct commercial SFO–YVR flight; ordinary genuine documents, matching identity, and all non-document airline checks are stipulated satisfied. No decision here guarantees admission at the Canadian border.

Only the declared citizenship and residence status apply. No unmentioned second passport, US/Canadian permanent-resident status, diplomatic exception, or other travel-permission exception is available.
Passenger names and document numbers are synthetic. Electronic authorization results are simulated carrier checks, never live calls and never a requirement to carry an eTA printout.
clues: The Indian passport holder lives permanently in the United States and says a green card is in the wallet.

questions.label: Ask for US permanent resident card
questions.response: Here is my valid Form I-551 green card.

rationale: The current passport plus the presented valid US green card establish the US lawful-permanent-resident exception. This passenger does not additionally require a Canadian visitor visa or eTA.
